objectives: Require publishers that sell or license videogames to consumers in the European Union (or related features and assets sold for videogames they operate) to leave said videogames in a working (playable) state.

summaries.en: Asks the EU to require game publishers to keep games they sold playable after they end support.
summaries.fr: Demande à l'UE d'obliger les éditeurs à garder jouables les jeux vendus après la fin de leur support.
